sources.label: Morphe Patches To Remove Ads From Facebook Lite
sources.author: Morphe FB Lite
patch_list: Clone install

Installs the patched app as a second copy next to the first, under an app name and package name you choose. The first start after installing only sets up; names hardcoded in the app's code are fixed from the second start.
Disable in-app browser
Opens links in the phone's default browser instead of Facebook Lite's built-in browser.
Double tap to seek
Double tap the left or right side of a reel or video to go back or forward 10 seconds. Switched in the Morphe settings screen.
Hide sponsored posts
Hides sponsored posts in the news feed and removes sponsored reels as they load.
Install beside Meta's apps
Lets the patched app install while Facebook, Messenger or other Meta apps are installed, by renaming the permissions it shares with them.
Morphe settings
Adds a settings screen to the app icon's long-press menu, with a font size slider.
Open profile when no reels
When a creator's Reels page says "No reels yet", opens their main profile for you (3 dot menu > View main profile). Switched in the Morphe settings screen.
Seek bar for short videos
Adds a seek bar and the back and forward 10 second buttons to reels and videos under a minute, when the app's own controls are not showing. Switched in the Morphe settings screen.
Skip creator's Reels page
When a creator's Reels page opens (tapping their name in a reel), always opens their main profile and its Reels tab, even when the page has reels. Switched in the Morphe settings screen.
Use system font
Blocks the downloaded Meta fonts (Optimistic, Instagram Sans, emoji, ...) so the app falls back to the system font.
Use system font in feed
Draws feed text with the system font instead of the font the server sends.
Video download and auto next reel
Adds a button to download the playing video in HD or SD (you choose the quality), and moves to the next reel when one ends. These are switched in the Morphe settings screen.
